action_name: 双手壶铃摆动：后期熟练者项目
method: built-in image_gen, one generation call per requested image or revision
reference_check: 三张step-image-references已用view_image阅读；来源动作库卡T-AXU-040及制作清单action-184已阅读；既有单图已检查，不自动复用。
source_document: E:/git冲突问题/安康_康复评估与分级训练动作库.md
checklist: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/动作分步骤示范图制作清单_v1.0.md#action-184
visual_review_method: 每次生成的完整图片预览逐张审查；保存后调用view_image，输出发生仅32像素缩略图显示的问题；s01额外用node_repl读取原PNG字节并emitImage完整复核。实际目视判断以完整生成预览及完整PNG显示为准。
group_consistency: 选用s01_v2与s03人物尺度和鞋位一致；s02斜侧角度及脚距稍有差异以显示两手；s04鞋底线约高2%画面高。四张相机为同一类安全斜侧机位、同画幅，生成输出不应宣称像素严格锁定。
global_limitations: 仅为来源卡既有胸前高度版本的关键姿势照片。静帧不证明技术熟练程度、髋驱动、实际负荷或安全资格，不替代原卡教学。未更改正式软件、制作清单、共享进度或旧单图。

images.target: 进入摆动的身前低位，双脚踩稳、双手提柄。
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: action 184 T-AXU-040 step s01, starting low-held position.
Input images: image 1 is accepted s02 and fixes exact diagonal side camera, stance width, shoe coordinates, image scale, floor, light, woman's identity and compact kettlebell. Image 2 is previous s01 and illustrates ONLY the upright low-held posture. Create the upright s01 from image 1's fixed camera, not image 2's narrower angle.
Same woman faces screen-right in the safe diagonal side view of image 1. Match her shoes and BOTH FEET POSITIONS EXACTLY to image 1, same comfortably wide stance on level floor. She is standing almost upright, hips and knees naturally near extension without locking, spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, no backwards lean. Both arms descend naturally in front of thighs. TWO separate hands firmly grip side-by-side ONE compact dark gray kettlebell's wide top handle, and the round bell hangs in front of the lower hips at thigh height, fully above the floor. Show both wrists, both closed hands and continuous handle-to-bell connection clearly. Same kettlebell shape and size as image 1. This is the low held starting position, not floor pickup, not chest position.
White short-sleeve shirt, charcoal long pants, white athletic shoes, black low ponytail, natural calm face, softly mottled gray-blue studio background and matching floor, soft diffused photographic light. Portrait 4:5 same canvas and full-body camera distance as image 1, both shoe baselines and placement unchanged, enough headroom and all shoes, head, ponytail and bell inside margins. Natural normal proportions.
No text, labels, numbers, arrows, logos, watermark, multiple poses, extra limbs, duplicate objects or motion trails. One person, one coherent still posture and one small round kettlebell.

review.identity: 同一女性、白短袖深灰裤黑马尾、灰蓝棚拍、白色运动鞋，面容自然
review.pose: 斜侧面朝右，两脚平地分开支持，身体中立直立，两手分辨且稳握单只壶铃，铃在身前低位。
review.proportion: 全身与铃完整，握柄连贯，未见多肢或器械穿模。
review.limitations: 生成图脚位与s02较接近但非像素严格一致，近鞋底线差约1%画面高；静态画面不能证实负荷和起铃技术。

images.target: 回摆关键位，髋后移膝自然弯、躯干中立髋铰链前倾，双手握柄。
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one photorealistic full-body educational studio photograph.
Reference image: identity, clothes, shoes, one compact dark gray kettlebell, gray-blue studio style only. Same East Asian woman, same black low ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal pants, white athletic shoes.
Primary request: two-handed kettlebell swing BACKSWING. Both feet firmly planted slightly wider than shoulder width. Hips pushed backward; torso hinged forward from the hips about 45 degrees, straight neutral spine; knees mildly bent, hips high well above knees. Straight arms pass between thighs toward a rearward kettlebell. BOTH hands grip ONE broad rounded handle side-by-side, fingers closed firmly around it. Show both separate hand grips and the continuous handle in the open space BETWEEN HER LEGS without occlusion by either thigh. One compact bell swings backward between legs, suspended above floor behind knee line, no intersection with legs. Kettlebell is one round solid weight with single wide handle and a flat base, same compact size as reference, never a dumbbell.
CAMERA: safe DIAGONAL SIDE VIEW, camera about 45 degrees in front of true side, outside swing path, woman still facing screen-right. The camera must look into the gap between the thighs to show BOTH hand grips on the same handle. Realistically space the legs so no hand or handle is hidden by near thigh. Both arms naturally connected from shoulders to two separate wrists and hands. Face is diagonal right profile. Show clear side shape of hip hinge, not straight front view. No deep squat.
Portrait 4:5 approximately 1122 by 1402, full head, complete ponytail, both hands, one bell, both full shoes within ample margins; waist-height camera and normal adult proportions. Soft gray-blue studio floor and seamless backdrop, natural contact shadows. Neutral expression, relaxed shoulders. Neck neutral with gaze naturally forward/down. No words, arrows, labels, numbers, split panels, duplicate limbs, logos, watermark, blur or movement trail. One coherent single posture.

review.identity: 人物、服装、灰蓝背景一致。
review.pose: 髋后移且髋高于膝，膝自然屈曲，两臂入腿间，两手分别握同一铃柄，回摆器械悬于腿间未落地。
review.proportion: 全身完整，单只壶铃比例自然，完整两脚接地；未见铃穿身或铃体分裂。
review.limitations: 近侧腿仍自然遮挡少量铃柄左侧及铃体，但两手握持、右柄接铃体关系可辨；斜侧机位使回摆纵深仍需配合文字说明。

images.target: 髋伸展直立，双手传递壶铃至胸前高度，未后仰或过头。
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: independent rehabilitation step photograph, action 184 T-AXU-040 s03, TOP of a chest-height two-handed kettlebell swing.
Input image: the supplied accepted s01 is the exact reference for the same woman, face, black ponytail, white short-sleeve shirt, charcoal pants, white trainers, gray-blue studio light, ONE compact dark-gray round kettlebell, fixed diagonal side camera, body scale, shoe positions and portrait 4:5 canvas.
Create the top swing phase from the SAME fixed camera. Match BOTH shoe positions, stance width, full floor contact and shoe baseline in reference. Woman remains facing screen-right and stands fully upright after hip extension, knees naturally near straight without locking, pelvis under ribs, neutral spine. No leaning backward and no lumbar arch. Head upright naturally.
BOTH nearly straight arms extend forward toward screen-right at approximately horizontal LOWER-CHEST height, slightly below shoulder height. Both shoulders stay naturally relaxed, not shrugged. Her own TWO distinct hands firmly grip side-by-side the same wide rounded upper handle of the ONE compact round kettlebell. Wrists neutral. The kettlebell has reached chest-front height and is fully visible in open space ahead, well below head and never overhead. This is the upper swing posture, not overhead lifting, not biceps curl, not squat. Maintain same kettle shape, matte material and compact size.
Frame all of head, ponytail, both complete shoes, both arms, hands and the bell with safe margins, including empty space beyond the bell at right. Maintain camera distance, normal adult proportions and the subject's overall scale. Softly mottled gray-blue background and level gray-blue floor, soft diffuse natural studio shadows. Single controlled posture.
No text, numbering, arrows, labels, logos, watermarks, graphic panels, extra fingers or limbs, multiple bells, motion trails or blur.

review.identity: 同一女性、服装、灰蓝背景、白鞋与s01_v2一致。
review.pose: 髋膝恢复直立、身体未明显后仰，两臂近水平伸向身前，两手握柄且铃到胸前高度未过头，双脚完整踩地。
review.proportion: 人物全身、两鞋、前臂和整铃入镜，器械尺度与s01_v2一致。
review.limitations: 远侧手臂在真实斜侧机位部分重叠，双腕及两手持柄关系仍可辨；静帧不能证明髋驱动或肌肉发力。

images.target: 停铃且铃底放回地面，双手仍见于提把。
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Correct ONLY the composition consistency and kettlebell size of the stopped-on-floor photograph.
Input images: image 1 is the fixed-camera s01 guide; image 2 is s04 to preserve its excellent stopped posture, two-handed grip and clear floor-supported bell.
Create corrected s04 with the same woman, face, hair, clothes, lighting, camera angle, body proportions, knee and hip hinge posture and clear two-hand grip as image 2. BOTH feet should occupy EXACTLY the same image positions as image 1. The image is 1122x1402, 4:5 portrait. Position near shoe sole at approximately y=1295, with the near shoe around x=430; far shoe sole approximately y=1205, far shoe around x=645. In image 2 both shoes are about 60 pixels too high; move the woman and floor-supported bell downward together by that amount, maintaining image 1's fixed-camera foot baseline. Keep full shoes and bell inside margins. Do not zoom out, do not rotate camera, do not shorten limbs.
ONE compact dark-gray kettlebell with round body and wide rounded handle must have the SAME SIZE AND SHAPE as image 1: a modestly small lightweight kettlebell, not a larger weight. Its FLAT BASE firmly contacts the floor just in front of the toes at screen-right, definite contact shadow and no air gap. Both hands visibly grip its upper handle side-by-side, wrists natural. The bell is upright and motionless on the floor, not hanging or swinging. Keep the photo of image 2's natural supported hip hinge: hips back and above knees, knees moderately flexed, spine long and neutral, arms down/forward reaching handle, both soles planted.
Scene identical gray-blue studio floor and seamless softly mottled backdrop, one woman and one kettlebell. Full head and ponytail, both arms and hands and both complete white shoes visible. No words, captions, arrows, numbers, logos, watermark, extra limbs, ghost frames or split panels. Preserve photorealism.

review.identity: 同一女性、服装、白鞋、单壶铃、灰蓝棚拍一致。
review.pose: 髋后移和膝自然屈曲，双手持续握柄，单铃直立在脚前地面且平底贴地有接触影，无抛放或空中摆铃。
review.proportion: 全身、完整两鞋、双手和单铃入镜；铃体与s01/s03接近。
review.limitations: 近鞋底线仍比s01/s03高约2%画面高，机位构图接近但不能宣称像素锁定；图片只展示停铃姿态，不能替代已学提放技术。
